components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#FFFFFF; border:1px solid rgba(46,70,54,0.10); border-radius:0; overflow:hidden; transition:border-color 500ms ease-out; } .ds-card:hover { border-color:rgba(176,143,76,0.35); } .ds-card__well { position:relative; height:320px; padding:32px; background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center, rgba(227,196,125,0.30) 0%, rgba(239,243,232,0.95) 75%); } .ds-card__pedestal { position:absolute; inset:0; background:inherit; } .ds-card__chip { position:absolute; top:16px; left:16px; padding:2px 10px; border:1px solid rgba(176,143,76,0.55); background:rgba(251,250,246,0.85); color:#755A22; font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:9px; letter-spacing:0.22em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-card__vintage { position:absolute; top:16px; right:16px; padding:2px 8px; border:1px solid rgba(46,70,54,0.15); background:rgba(251,250,246,0.85); color:#333A2F; font-family:'Geist Mono',monospace; font-size:10px; } .ds-card__body { padding:24px; } .ds-card__name { margin:0; font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-size:24px; font-weight:300; line-height:1.3; color:#14150F; } .ds-card__meta { margin:8px 0 0; color:#565C4E; font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12px; font-weight:300; } .ds-card__footer { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; margin-top:20px; padding-top:20px; border-top:1px solid rgba(46,70,54,0.10); } .ds-card__price { font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',Georgia,serif; font-size:20px; color:#755A22; } .ds-card__action { padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid rgba(46,70,54,0.20); border-radius:0; background:rgba(46,70,54,0.04); color:#14150F; font-family:Geist,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:0.2em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:border-color 300ms ease-out, color 300ms ease-out; } .ds-card__action:hover { border-color:#B08F4C; color:#755A22; }

narrative.overview:
LA CAVE is staged as the entrance hall of a chalk cellar at midday, not the candlelit vault the prestige-champagne category defaults to. Light is the material: a pale champagne-green veil on the hero, chalk-white reading surfaces for every catalogue and editorial page, and green deepening as the page descends toward the footer. Gold is a single lamp in that room — a primary action, a seal, a hairline — never a field.

The chromatic mandate is explicit and numeric: 60 % white, 30 % champagne green, 10 % champagne yellow, text in ink. Measured on the rendered homepage, that lands at roughly 43 % chalk/white, 57 % green family and 0.4 % gold on desktop, and 43 % chalk/white, 55 % green and 1.5 % gold on mobile, with gold concentrated in CTAs, seals and the hero halo. The brief's intent — a bright house, not a dark one — holds at every breakpoint.

The typography and layout of the house are unchanged by that recolouring: Cormorant Garamond in light weights for display, Geist for body copy, 9–10 px uppercase micro-labels tracked 0.2–0.3 em, hairline borders, square corners, and photography that is never recoloured, filtered or restaged.
keyCharacteristics: A 60/30/10 field of chalk, champagne green and champagne yellow, with ink text throughout.
Serif display at light weights, sans body, mono for prices, scores and vintages.
Square corners, hairline green borders, depth from tone and one radial halo.
Slow, restrained motion (300–500 ms, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), no bounce, no parallax gimmick.
Bottle photography preserved exactly as supplied, on a champagne pedestal gradient.

rules.name: The Daylight Rule
rules.body: The page field is light. No large ink or black surface is ever introduced to add "luxury"; depth comes from green tone steps, hairlines and photography.

rules.name: The Ten Percent Rule
rules.body: Champagne yellow may cover no more than a tenth of any viewport. It marks actions and provenance, never walls, never body text.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif never appears below 18 px; sans never appears above 24 px. A serif label or a sans display is a break in the house voice.

rules.name: The Band Rule
rules.body: A background may only change at a full-width hairline-separated band boundary. No floating coloured panels inside a reading column.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs separating and it is not floating over the page, use a 1 px border at 10–16 % green ink. Never add a card shadow to compensate for a missing tone step.

dos: Do keep the page field light: chalk #FBFAF6 or white for reading, green for atmosphere, and reach for a deeper green band to add weight.
Do hold champagne yellow under 10 % of any viewport and use it only for actions, seals and hairlines.
Do keep text ink #14150F, paragraphs #333A2F, metadata #565C4E or #585F50, and verify ≥4.5:1 on the green surfaces.
Do use 1 px green hairlines and square corners for separation.
Do preserve bottle photography exactly: no recolouring, no duotone, no heavy filters, object-contain on the pedestal.
Do keep touch targets at 44 px and lock body scroll behind drawers.
donts: Don't reintroduce black, near-black or dark-green fields as page backgrounds; the house is now daylight.
Don't use champagne yellow for body text, large fills or decorative stripes.
Don't add gradients other than the champagne pedestal and the hero's single gold halo.
Don't round buttons, cards or inputs; only the circular seal is round.
Don't replace a hairline with a shadow to separate flat surfaces.
Don't retitle, rewrite or translate the French copy while restyling; the words are part of the house.
